SELECT id, page, text, value, unit, about FROM measures WHERE (unit ILIKE '%kg%' OR unit ILIKE '%$%' OR unit ILIKE '%USD%') OR array_to_string(about, ' ') ILIKE '%cost%'
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page IN (9,10) ORDER BY page, line_no
